calls.title: Obrio<>GrowthBook - Account Merge Discussion
calls.summary: The meeting outlined a comprehensive account migration strategy, emphasizing the merging of three separate platform accounts into a single unified account with minimal risk and disruption. A temporary fourth account will be created for migration testing to validate SDK payloads and ensure the continuity of active features and experiments. The team plans to migrate around 300 active features while preserving experiment history and excluding disabled features. Maintaining stable API endpoints and proper metrics management is crucial to avoid duplication and support ongoing experiments. Each platform's projects will exist in parallel under the main organization to preserve isolation. Lastly, a detailed migration plan will be developed to ensure all active experiments remain operational throughout the transition.
calls.keywords: Account Migration, Feature Flags, Experiments, API Endpoint, Metrics, Cross-Platform Testing
calls.action_items:
**Graham McNicoll**
Discuss the migration situation internally with the team and devise a detailed migration plan (27:19)
Create a fourth organization account to consolidate and test merged data before final migration (19:19)
Provide Obrio access to the test account for validation of SDK endpoints and data correctness (27:19)

**Artem Gryschuk**
Verify with the analytics team if metrics from different accounts need to be migrated or can be skipped if duplicated (11:50)
Confirm all features, experiments, saved groups, and attributes that must be migrated, excluding deprecated and disabled features (12:57)
Validate the migration by testing the fourth organization once access is provided (27:09)

**Denys Lebid**
Support coordination on Obrio side for confirming migration requirements and communication with internal analytics and platform teams (11:50)
